segments.comment: Names the request-menu prefix with #reqmenu before each of the eight directions, twice, beside the starting pet. cmd.c rhack() 3762-3773 reads the direction at got_prefix_input, below the reset of iflags.menu_requested at 3635, so set_move_cmd() sets context.nopick and the hero begs the pet's pardon instead of swapping places with it.
